# OrbitVision

> OrbitVision provides telecommunications and IT installation services based in Glenrothes, Fife, Scotland, serving homes, businesses and farms across the UK.

## Services
- Satellite broadband installation (Starlink and Amazon Leo / Project Kuiper)
- Business broadband and cloud communications
- Data cabling and on-premise communication systems
- CCTV and access control
- Managed I.T. services
- Installation and ongoing maintenance

## Coverage
UK-wide, with particular focus on rural, remote and agricultural sites as well as urban business premises.
